summary: Views persist sorts, filters, hiddenColumns, and columnOrder; view create/delete/rename mutates data.views and saves.
Filters are view-scoped and save each add/change/delete; gt/lt gates on numeric/date/formula result kind.
Sort rules are persisted as multiple view-scoped rules, but fetched getSortedRows applies only the first rule.
Embeds with aliases select matching views or create/save a new locked view with empty rule arrays.
Formula expressions are stored id-based, recomputed write-through into row.cells, and cached with formulaResultKind.
Formula parser/evaluator grammar and simple renderer internals remain unfetched; columnOrder writer remains unresolved.
